visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) This is a 2D digital animation set against a solid light tan, minimalist background. A red countertop-style oven is positioned in the center, with its door open and a metallic tray extended forward. A plump yellow-and-white cartoon cat with a tiny black and red hat jumps onto the tray from the bottom of the frame, landing with its mouth closed and wide eyes looking forward. (2) The scene maintains the static camera angle and tan background. The yellow cat walks forward, entering the oven cavity as the metallic tray slides inward. The oven door snaps shut. A bright, colorful gradient of green and yellow light pulses from behind the glass door, accompanied by small white star-shaped sparkles that briefly obscure the interior. (3) The oven door opens again, revealing a different cat: an orange tabby with thick brown stripes and a sad, drooping expression. The tray remains inside the oven. After a moment, the door closes once more, and a pink and purple gradient light pulses with white sparkles, indicating a transformation or 'baking' process. (4) The door opens a final time to reveal a solid black cat with massive, glowing yellow pupils and a round body. The black cat jumps forward onto the extending tray, then hops down to the floor area below the frame. It stretches its back and briefly lays down before the animation transitions. (5) The screen becomes clear of the oven and cats. A line of Traditional Chinese text appears in the center of the frame, written in a dark brown, rounded font. The text remains static for several seconds against the same tan background before the video ends. No other objects or characters are present.
